description: Keep one wait for peer mail running in every Claude process of a registered zmx-peer-chat pair: at session start (including the new process Happy starts on each mode switch), when a prompt is submitted, and when a turn ends or fails. An interrupted turn fires no Stop hook, so the next prompt re-arms the wait. asyncRewake hands the mail to Claude as a system reminder and wakes it even when idle. Outside a registered Claude session the command exits at once, and a second wait in the same pair exits at once too.
